name: PNS Addons for Elementor
author: Partho Samadder

sections.description:
PNS Addons for Elementor is a comprehensive suite of premium, highly customizable widgets and sliders designed specifically for the Elementor page builder.

Included Features & Widgets:

  • Interactive Sliders & Carousels: Modern Slider, Accordion Slider, Member, Video Popup Cards.
  • Content & Layout Widgets: What We Do Grid, Sticky Project, Progress Timeline, Promo Banner Card, Footer, HTML Table.
  • Grid & Showcase Widgets: Card Grid, Logo Carousel, Dual Heading, Testimonial.
  • Creative & Animated Widgets: Animated Heading, Animated Image Gallery (with Fullscreen Lightbox), PNS FAQ Accordion, Marquee Text, Animated Button, Image Hover Cards, Timeline, Pricing Table, Progress Bar, Flip Box.
  • Widget Manager: Enable or disable any widget individually to optimize site performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pns-addons-for-elementor directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to PNS Addons in your admin menu to manage your active widgets.
  4. Open any page in Elementor and drag widgets from the “PNS Addons” category into your layout.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor Page Builder must be installed and activated on your WordPress site.

Can I disable widgets I don’t use?

Yes! Use the built-in PNS Addons Settings page in your WordPress admin to enable or disable any widget individually.

Are all widgets customizable?

Yes! You can customize typography, colors, padding, layout, and content directly within the Elementor editor panel.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • New Widget: Animated Heading Widget featuring dynamic typewriter, rotating words, and highlight animation styles.
  • New Widget: Animated Image Gallery Widget with seamless 4-3 asymmetrical mosaic pattern, 100% cover display, and diagonal shine hover animation.
  • Enhancement: Built-in fullscreen image lightbox viewer with vector SVG controls, frosted glass design, and immunity against theme CSS overrides.
  • Enhancement: Fully responsive layout for all widgets across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.

1.0.3

  • Fix: Auto-flush Elementor CSS file cache on plugin activation and reactivation so designs restore seamlessly.
  • Fix: Auto-clear Elementor cache on saving Widget Manager settings.
  • Enhancement: Database persistence safeguard ensuring widget designs and layouts remain intact on deactivation.

1.0.2

  • Fix: Sticky Project stacking card scroll sticky behavior on all screen resolutions.
  • Fix: Automatic ancestor container overflow correction to prevent theme clipping.
  • Enhancement: Smooth interactive 3D scale and depth transitions on scroll.
  • Performance: Hardware-accelerated transforms for sticky card animation.

1.0.1

  • New: Built-in Admin Settings and Widget Manager dashboard.
  • New: Individual toggle switches to enable or disable widgets.
  • New: Bulk actions (Enable All, Disable All) and category filtering.
  • Performance: Conditional asset loading (CSS & JS only load for active widgets).
  • Performance: Swiper bundle only loads when slider widgets are enabled.
  • Security: Full input sanitization and nonce verification.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of PNS Addons for Elementor with custom widgets and sliders.
